verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and integration use cases such as syncing an external HR system, maintaining employee data, check creation, and recurring deductions. These are integrations into Paychex's own branded service, not a white-label partner API for embedding payroll inside a third-party product. Nothing in the evidence mentions embedded payroll, white-labeling, or a partner/reseller embedding program, so this adjacent integration capability earns no credit.
